subject.title: fix: treat empty-string optional integer tool params as unset

question: Should blank strings be treated as absent by the shared plugin-SDK integer readers, or should this fix be scoped to Telegram/channel routing parameters only?
rationale: The shared fix is the cleanest owner-boundary repair for the bug, but it changes exported helper behavior for all bundled and external plugin-style callers.

options.title: Accept shared-reader relaxation
options.body: Treat blank strings as unset for optional integer readers across the SDK, matching existing blank handling in readNumberParam and avoiding per-channel sanitizers.

options.title: Scope to Telegram routing
options.body: Keep the exported integer readers strict and sanitize blank reply/thread ids only in Telegram or message-routing code, reducing SDK contract change at the cost of duplicated policy.

recommendation.title: Accept shared-reader relaxation
recommendation.body: Treat blank strings as unset for optional integer readers across the SDK, matching existing blank handling in readNumberParam and avoiding per-channel sanitizers.

likelyOwner.reason: The available current-main blame ties the shared reader and Telegram action-runtime code to this area contributor.
